groups.title: Microservices Patterns
groups.question: Explain how you decide where to draw service boundaries and how services should talk to each other.

followUps.Service Decomposition & Bounded Contexts: What goes wrong when you split a monolith by technical layer instead of by domain?
followUps.Inter-Service Communication: Sync vs Asy: What do you gain and give up when you switch a sync HTTP call between services to an async event?

groups.title: gRPC & Protocol Buffers
groups.question: Explain how gRPC and Protocol Buffers work for service-to-service calls and how they differ from REST with JSON.

followUps.Protocol Buffers & Code Generation: Why is changing a field number in a proto file a breaking change?
followUps.gRPC Streaming & Error Model: Why should a gRPC service return a real status code instead of OK with an error payload?

groups.title: Apache Kafka
groups.question: Explain how Kafka stores and delivers messages and how you use it from a Python service.

followUps.Kafka Topics, Partitions & Consumer Grou: How does the partition count limit consumer parallelism, and when do you commit offsets?
followUps.Kafka with Python — confluent-kafka & ai: What happens if you use a blocking Kafka client inside an async service, and what does a schema registry protect against?

groups.title: Resilience Patterns
groups.question: Explain how you keep a distributed system usable when one service fails or slows down, and how you find the cause.

followUps.Circuit Breakers & Retries: How does a circuit breaker stop one dead dependency from taking down the whole call chain?
followUps.Distributed Tracing with OpenTelemetry: How does a trace connect one user request across several services?
